Using only the clues below, match each chef to his or her entree, and determine the score it received and the name of the restaurant each chef works at. Remember, as with all grid-based logic puzzles, no option in any category will ever be used more than once.
inputs.constraints:
1. Of Nelson and the cook who scored 63 points, one made the lemon snapper and the other made the cajun chili.
2. Of the chef who scored 42 points and the cook who scored 63 points, one made the cashew tofu and the other was Rosalie.
3. Karl scored 7 more points than the person who made the lemon snapper.

dishes: cajun chili; cashew tofu; lemon snapper; smoked pork.

- It links a chef to a dish and a score.

- It is the **minimum** number of predicates needed (only one is required to model the full mapping).

---

### Final Answer

```
match(Chef, Dish, Score)
```

employee: "Bonita"; "Yvette"; "Tabitha".
